description:
FILED s533b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-03) from the port's block-twin probes (the brief asked for a `package NAME { }` twin of each silent wrong); PRE-EXISTING on the base 4fb60297 and NOT reached by the requalifier port (the block form opens no switched region).

REPRODUCER (probed vs perl 5.40.3; scratch/s533b/pr/K1.pl, A7b.pl in the s533b worktree):

    sub run { package P { $x = 5; our $o = 1; } }
    run();
    print "main=", $main::x // "u", " P=", $P::x // "u", " Po=", $P::o // "u", "\n";

perl:  main=u P=5 Po=1
PCL (base 4fb60297 and s533b): main=5 P=u Po=1   -- SILENT WRONG: the global write lands in main::.

WHY: a `package NAME { BLOCK }` is lowered as its own SECTION (in-package NAME) only at file level and inside a flattened bare block; inside a sub body (or any block lowered in place) the block's statements are read by the CL reader in the ENCLOSING package, and nothing requalifies their bare globals.  The `our` declarator is right (the lowering's package stack knows P), the bare global is not.  `_requalify_block_globals_after_pkg_switch` only opens regions at `package NAME;` STATEMENTS (`_pkg_stmt_has_block` excludes the block form, correctly for the file-level case).  Inside a `package X;` region the port now homes such a nested block's globals right (the binder's positional package, Pl/t/requalify-binder-01.t row 7); outside a region nothing does.

FIX SHAPE (not designed): the requalifier opens a region for a block-form package whose block is lowered IN PLACE (not split into a section), with home = its namespace; the binder already answers the positional package for every ref (`requalify_home` -> global -> perl_package), so the work is the region opener's predicate (which blocks are not sections), not the resolution.  Name-resolution change: the full sweep is the gate.


=== DONE (s535a) ===
(Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08, resumed s536; commit "s535a D2: the package-region residues on the binder".)  SITE: the requalifier opened regions only for `package NAME;` statements; a block-form `package NAME { BLOCK }` that is not a section of its own (a sub body, an `if` block, a string eval's collapsed region, another package block) was read by the CL reader in the enclosing package.  FIX: `_requalify_inplace_pkg_blocks` (Parser2, called once the segments are known) opens a requalifier region of NAME for each such block, deepest first; the binder's positional package homes each global (no new walk).  Probes perl / base / tree: `sub run { package P { $x = 5 } }` -> perl main=u P=5, base main=5 P=u, tree = perl (d4421 / d4421b / d4421c: a flattened bare block, an `if` block in a sub, a string eval, a nested package block, an outer `our`).  Guards Pl/t/span-binder-01.t rows 10-12 (FAIL on 06a4b8ba).  ir-spec §1 names the region shape.  Status left as it is.

=== COMPLETED (s536, reviewing session, 2026-11-08) === merged as MAIN-READY-77 fcfce8a5 (s535a, 1c port 3: the span pass on the binder); review probes perl -> main ab0df658 -> tree (scratchpad p535a/a.pl b.pl): tree = perl; no live baseline row keys on this task (CLOSE-WITH-ROWS checked).
